visual_name: Day in the life, part forty four: the office chair (low-poly 3D)
code_name: three.js car wash on a sunny day (a tunnel cut away at the front with two upright brushes and one overhead brush that spin, a CAR WASH sign, a teal car in the open bay, a blue bucket he sits on, a hose reel, cones, a pay station, puddles), flying foam and foam that stays on his head, box-built attendant with a bald head, a full black beard, a lime polo, navy shorts, yellow rubber boots and orange gloves, a sponge, phone sheets for his post with two hundred tags / their feed with a flame under every post / their office chair, liked / the follow back (a bot) / YourBrand Profile (headline, Discoverable to brands, My top 3 videos) then Browse creators with Invite to campaign / the chair, still, hard cuts on voiceover word times
summary: A 40.8 second 9:16 reel in low-poly 3D: a car wash attendant tags brands on every post on his break: two hundred tags, a fire comment on everything they post for a year, a like on a photo of their office chair. One follow back: a bot. So he films in the car wash for attention, and the brushes win. Then YourBrand: his Profile, a headline, his top three videos, one switch, Discoverable to brands; brands browse the directory and invite him. He still comments on the chair. It's a good chair.
